{{Quote|Word from our undercover team and their informants is that someone is offering explosives and arms on the black market. It's amazing how fast this scum flows in to fill the gaps. Time for us to move in. And only one warning before you open fire, okay? Let's see how much we can clean up once and for all.|Organized Crime Unit squad briefing, CSF HQ|<ref name="TripleZero" />}}
The '''Organized Crime Unit'''—abbreviated as the '''OCU'''—was a division of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and countered complex criminal organizations that proved to be far more of a threat than small-time crime. The unit was based out of the [[Coruscant Security Force Headquarters]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The OCU used undercover teams to provide intelligence on criminal organizations and worked closely with the CSF's [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] (ATU) under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]].<ref name="TripleZero" />

During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TripleZero" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the OCU assisted ATU and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] during a special [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] to take down [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] networks on Coruscant. At the close of the mission, the OCU participated in a massive overnight raid operation during which 97 terrorists were captured or [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After that, the OCU and ATU hosted a celebration at the [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club]] for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="TripleZero" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Organized Crime Unit first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', published on [[February 28]], [[2006]] and written by [[Karen Traviss]].
